patterns.note: Full-bleed product photography and vibrant gradient backgrounds are used as hero and section backdrops, often with dark overlays for text contrast.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, contrasting with smaller, legible body text and very small, uppercase labels for statistics and feature titles.
A high-contrast palette of deep blacks and whites is accented by vibrant, luminous gradients (teal-blue and purple-blue) used for background sections and subtle overlays.
Key sections feature sticky background images (product shots or gradients) that remain fixed or subtly parallax while descriptive text content scrolls over them, creating a layered reveal effect.

Product feature sections are structured with a large image on one side and a series of short, punchy text descriptions with associated statistics on the other, often within a dark, immersive background.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex scroll-based animations, including sections revealing with a subtle fade-up or slide-up as they enter the viewport.

Implements a sticky image effect where full-bleed background images are pinned to the viewport for a duration, allowing multiple text blocks to scroll sequentially over them before the next section unpins and scrolls normally.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect on its background image as the user scrolls, adding depth to the initial view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Massive, bold hero headings (~6x body) with large, bold section titles (~3x body), complemented by small, uppercase labels (~0.7x body) and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across all elements, including product images, buttons, and section edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with an airy hero section and immersive full-bleed imagery, transitioning to a more structured, balanced spacing in feature lists.

standout: The site's distinctive use of sophisticated scroll-triggered animations, particularly the sticky background images that allow multiple content blocks to scroll over them, creates an immersive and dynamic storytelling experience. This, combined with the vibrant gradient accents against a dark, minimal canvas, elevates the product presentation beyond a standard marketing site.
